green_vs_postcured_datasheets.material: Formlabs Standard resins (Clear FLGPCL04 etc.), Form 2, 100 um layers
green_vs_postcured_datasheets.conditions: green = washed and air dried without post cure; post-cured = 1.25 mW/cm2 of 405 nm for 60 min at 60 C (4.5 J/cm2)
post cure = in water under 405 nm at 200 mW/cm2 for one minute (12 J/cm2); recommended layer exposure 2.5-3.5 s at 3.5-4.5 mW/cm2 (about 9-16 mJ/cm2 per 50 um layer)
